question.text: Expense Ratio of 1.5% on an MF returning 12% gross, net return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Net = Gross - TER = 12% - 1.5% = 10.5%. The Trap: Gross is pre-TER. Cross-Exam Context: Basic math. Manager's Pro-Tip: TER compounds over decades — 50 bps difference = ~15-20% wealth difference over 20 years.
